Commentary.Commentary: The wicket is playing well but there is some assistance for the bowlers. The home side will back themselves to chase this down. The tourists will have to bowl really well in order to defend this score to stay alive in the series. Join us in a while for the chase.

The Indian bowlers did not start off well. Even their spinners could not provide the breakthrough in the middle overs and they were leaking runs. Towards the end some smart bowling from Kuldeep and Chahal and some brilliant death bowling by the pace bowlers made sure Australia did not run away with the game. The Indian bowling conceded only 59 in the last ten and managed to pick 4 wickets.

So, India have done really well to pull things back here. After winning the toss and opting to bat the Australians got off to an ideal start with Finch and Warner stitching a good partnership. The former scored a magnificent ton on his return and he was well supported by his skipper Smith. However, after the fall of these two, the visitors completely lost their way courtesy some poor batting and excellent death bowling by the hosts.
Good length around off, Stoinis pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 293/6!
Full and outside off, Agar punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Smart batting! Bumrah bowls it around leg, Agar gets across and swings it wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
Full toss around off, Agar clips it through mid-wicket. Pandey does well to run to his left and stops the ball. Two runs taken.
Punches it through covers for a single.
WIDE! Slants one around middle and leg, Stoinis shuffles and fails to clip it through.
WIDE! The slower one gone wrong, wide outside off. Stoinis cannot reach it. Another wide.
Good length angling into the batsman who was walking away, Stoinis can only defend it back down the wicket.
Full and outside off, Agar swings at it but misses.
Dead ball as Kumar slips one out of his hands. But hang on, one of the umpire has signaled a no ball. They get together and decide that it is not a no ball.
Very full outside off, Stoinis carves it through covers for a single.
Wide outside off, Agar looks to flay one but gets it off the toe end. Slices it just short of the man coming in from sweeper cover. A single taken.
Yorker outside off, Stoinis jams it towards wide long off for a single.
Yorker around middle, clipped through mid on for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven to sweeper point for a single.
Bowls it around middle and leg, Stoinis cannot clip it through. The ball goes off his pads for a leg bye towards fine leg. Signaled a run so maybe there was a bit of bat there.
Ashton Agar walks out to bat.

OUT! Ice cool stuff by Pandey! Fuller in length outside off, Handscomb walks down the wicket and goes through with his lofted shot. Pandey at long off, gets under it and takes the catch. He spots that he is going over the ropes and hence throws it up in the air. Comes back in and completes the catch. The umpire refers it upstairs to be sure. Replays confirm that it was a clean catch and hence Peter has to go back. Bumrah has two wickets. Post October, this catch won't be allowed since you cannot touch the ground beyond the ropes while trying to complete the catch.

They are going upstairs to check whether Manish Pandey has taken the catch cleanly at the long off boundary. It did look clean and if he has taken it, it is a stunning one. Peter Handscomb is the man in question.
Good length around off, Stoinis backs away and punches it towards extra cover for a single.
Slower one, fuller in length outside off, dragged towards deep square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.
Slower one outside off, Stoinis looks to guide it through covers but misses it.
Another cutter outside off, Peter has a wild swing at it but misses.
Length ball outside off, Handscomb looks to swing it away but misses.
Full toss outside off, hit hard to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Powerful! Yorker on middle, Stoinis just stands tall and clobbers it down the ground for a boundary. That was hit too well and hence Pandya from long off could not cut it off.
WIDE! A wide ball, way outside off.

CLOSE! Good length outside off, Handscomb punches it towards covers and takes off for a single. Chahal has a lot of time to score a direct hit at the striker's end but misses. Stoinis had given up completely there. Lucky break for him, can he make it count?
Length outside off, cut towards point for a single.
WIDE! Bowls it way wide outside off, Stoinis cannot reach it. Another wide.
Yorker just outside off, pushed towards mid off. The fielder does well to not allow the run as Stoinis was keen on it. Pandey was the man there.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side, left alone. Wide signaled. India have bowled quite a few of those today.
Good length around off, tapped towards the leg side for a quick single. Bumrah picks up the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good length around off, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Peter Handscomb is the new man in.
OUT! Timber! Slower one around middle, Head plays all around this one and is bowled all ends up. The wickets keep coming for India. Head has to walk back to the hut now. Bumrah has a wicket.
Back of a length around off, comes in, Stoinis looks to tuck it but gets it off the back thigh, through his legs for a leg bye. That must have hurt.
Good length around off, Stoinis defends it back down the wicket.
Time for Jasprit Bumrah!
Fuller outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Bowls a yorker just outside off, Stoinis jams it out towards the off side.
WIDE! Sprays it wide outside off, no shot offered.
Bowls it just outside off, Stoinis keeps it out from his crease.
Bowls it wide outside off, Head angles it towards point for a single. That was in fact of the bottom edge.

NOT OUT! Stoinis survives! Kumar hurls it around off, Marcus gets across and turns it towards the leg side for a single. The bowler is appealing for an lbw but nothing by the umpire. The Indians are confident and go for the review. Replays show that it was indeed pad first but the impact was outside the line and hence he survives.
A review against Stoinis by India. That looks like pad first but is it in line?
Good length outside off, Stoinis punches it towards point from his crease.
Time for a change, Bhuvneshwar Kumar brought back on.
Flatter around middle, nudged through square leg for a single. Kuldeep has been expensive but has taken two vital wickets for his side.
Fuller around off, driven through mid off for a single.
Shorter outside off, comes in, punched towards covers by Travis.
Taps this one into covers for a quick single. Smart batting, this.
SIX! Dispatched! Fuller outside off, Stoinis gets under it and launches it over long off for a maximum. 250 up for Australia!
Loops it outside off, driven through extra cover for a single.
Tossed up wide outside off, Stoinis is not Maxwell and does not fall for it. Left alone. End of a good spell by Chahal. His figures read 10-0-54-1!
Shorter in length around off, Stoinis stays back and defends it.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off for a single. Rohit scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but no harm done.
Off the mark. Shorter outside off, punched behind point for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, Stoinis turns it towards the leg side.
Marcus Stoinis walks out to bat. Australia's hitters continue to come along.

OUT! Chahal is laughing as Maxwell is stumped. Bowls it wide outside off expecting a charge. Maxwell throws himself at it but cannot connect. Dhoni does the rest and the promotion has not worked for the Australians. Michael Hussey on-air is absolutely livid with Glenn for falling for the bait like that. Two in two for India!
Travis Head is the new man in.

OUT! Kuldeep strikes again! Bowls the wrong one around off, Smith comes down the wicket looking to go big but miscues it completely. Bumrah gets under it at long off and takes it safely. Smith knew he had not hit that well and now has to depart. Indians have managed to pull things back a touch. Two wickets for Kuldeep and he will be happy with them.
Maxwell stays back and pumps it to long on for a single.
WIDE! This one is bowled down the leg side, very flat. Left alone again.
WIDE! Too far wide outside off, Maxwell lets it go. Wide signaled.
Punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Bowls it wide outside off, Smith comes down and places it through backward point for a couple of runs.
Drags this one towards long on for a single. He is going too hard at the moment.
Bowls it outside off, shorter in length, Maxwell clubs it hard towards extra cover.
Kuldeep returns for his final spell. Maxwell has often him around so it will be a challenge.
Drives this full ball towards covers. A good over by Chahal, just the 2 runs from it.
This time Chahal slows it up wide outside off, Smith adjusts well to defend it watchfully coming down the wicket.
Flatter on middle, Smith keeps it out from his crease.
Bowls it wide outside off, Maxwell was looking to slog but cannot reach it. Ends up smashing it towards long off for a single.
Shorter outside off, Smith looks to drag it through but gets it off the toe end of the bat behind him, towards square leg for a single.
Flatter around off and middle, Smith goes back and defends it.

Powerplay 3 has been signaled by the umpire. Five fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings. Also, Yuzvendra Chahal is back into the attack. He has been expensive today but a wicket or two here will be very handy.
On a length on middle and leg, tucked to short mid-wicket.
Maxwell makes room and Bumrah smartly follows him. He adjusts to work it to mid on.
Low full toss well outside off, Glenn reaches out to it to carve it to backward point.
Off-cutter on off, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Similar length delivery outside off, glided to third man for a single.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to point.
Jasprit Bumrah is back for a bowl.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Slower delivery on a fullish length outside off, Smith looks to force it through but gets a thick outside edge through the vacant slip region for a boundary. A good spell from Pandya comes to an end.
Back of a length outside off, placed through point for a run.

That was weird! Shortish delivery on off, Maxwell initially looks to drop his wrists but the ball stays a bit low.  He eventually looks to run it down to third man but ends up gloving it to backward point.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Length delivery on off, tucked through backward square leg for a couple.
Good length delivery, defended off the back foot.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Glenn Maxwell strides out to bat. This is an ideal stage for him to showcase his big-hitting abilities.

OUT! Finch departs after a tremendous knock! Quicker delivery and on a fullish length on off, Finch clears his front leg and heaves it over mid-wicket. He has got the power behind it but not the elevation. Kedar Jadhav in the deep bends and pouches it safely. For one moment, it seemed that he has dropped it but it was because his handkerchief fell down. This was the quickest delivery that Yadav has bowled till now and it is brought the downfall of the dynamic opener. Relief for India finally. They need to chip away at the wickets.
Shortish delivery on off, Finch punches it off the back foot through wide mid on. Rahane in the deep races to his right and slides to make a great stop. Saves two runs for his side.
Smith works this one with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Smith uses his feet and clips it to mid-wicket.

Pandya goes wide of the crease and angles in a full length delivery to Smith. He goes across but seems to have got an inside edge onto his pads. The Indians appeal but the umpire stays put. The ball rolls to short fine leg and the batsmen take a run. That brings up his 19th ODI fifty. Sensible knock from the Australia skipper so far!
Short outside off, punched through cover-point for a run. 150-run stand up between the duo. Great going!
Fractionally overpitched outside off, driven crisply to extra cover for a run.
Slower one on off, Finch looks to play it across but gets an inside edge on to his pads. The ball rolls to short third man. A run taken.
Fullish delivery outside off, Smith caresses it through covers for a run.
On a length on leg stump, Smith looks to clip it away but is struck on the thigh pad.

SIX! Miscues from Finch are going the distance! Floated on middle, Finch goes hard at it and mistimes it down the ground. However, the ball sails over long off. He is making most of the short boundaries.
Slower through the air down the leg side, helped to fine leg for a run.
Wrong one from Yadav. Smith reads it and cuts it to covers.
Straying on the pads again, clipped in front of square on the leg side.
On leg stump, Finch stays back and turns it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery, Smith pushes it to mid on to rotate strike.
Wide! Quicker delivery down the leg side, Smith looks to sweep it hard but misses.

Time for Drinks. Great batting from Finch and Smith. The former is especially looking ominous. This pair is providing the perfect platform for the middle order to capitalize upon. The pitch has eased out now. The visitors will know that they need a big score to test the famed Indian batting line-up.
Fuller in length, Finch defends it nicely.
Wide! This is poor bowling from Pandya, he is not bowling according to his fields. Slips this one down the leg side, Finch misses out on his tuck.
Slower delivery on a length outside off, Aaron dabs it to point.
Wide! Pandya loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side. Finch just has to get a little bat to it to beat short fine leg but he fails to do so. Dhoni does well to stop it on the bounce.
FOUR! Shot! Short delivery on off, sits up nicely for Finch. He stands tall and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wiclet. No protection in the deep and he gets the desired result!
On a length, Aaron hangs back and pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Angling into Finch. He knows where the gaps are. Tucks it through backward square leg for a brace.
Fine leg and third man are both inside the circle.
Fullish in length, Smith works it to long on for a single.
Floated on middle, eased towards mid on.
Stays back and blocks this one.
SIX! Stand and deliver! Tossed up on off, Finch clears his front leg and tonks it over long on for a huge maximum. Dangerous signs for India.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! Well played, Finch! What a brilliant knock it has been. Floated around leg stump, Finch kneels and sweeps it hard through fine leg for a boundary. He is ecstatic and pumps his fist in the air. This is his 8th ODI ton, truly well-deserved! After coming back from an injury, it is not easy to play such an innings.
Down the leg side, helped to fine leg for a run.
Length delivery on off, driven back to Pandya who dives to his right in his followthrough to make a brilliant stop.

Good length delivery outside off, Aaron camps back and punches it through backward point. Takes on Chahal in the deep and comes back for the second with ease. Finch has been running really well between the wickets, doesn't look like he is coming back from a calf injury.
Fuller in length on off, Finch turns it to short mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Finch makes use of the depth of the crease to block it. He is only five away from a terrific century.
Fuller in length outside off, stays low. Finch looks to push it through covers but misses.
Sloppy! Fuller in length on off, driven crisply to extra cover where Kohli unnecessarily throws it at the bowler's end but misses. Concedes a run.
Hardik Pandya is back on. India need wickets.

Interesting observation from Sanjay Manjrekar. Kuldeep's fastest ball is at 83.3 kph, while that of Chahal is 90 kph. The slowness through the air is what has not helped him so far and Manjrekar informs that it has been an issue with Yadav.
Floated in line of the stumps, Finch puts his head down and defends it calmly.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Spinning down leg, Smith looks to sweep it to fine leg but misses. As Steven shuffled across, it is not signaled as a wide.
Around middle and leg, Finch pulls it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Smith works this one with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up delivery, eased to long on for a run.
Fullish on middle and leg, Finch eases it to long on for a run.
Again a fraction short outside off, Smith places it to deep point to rotate strike.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut through cover-point. A run taken.
Fullish on middle, Smith milks it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up around off, eased to covers.
FOUR! Well played! Australia are talking the attack to the opposition. Tossed up on off, Smith uses his feet and clip it uppishly over mid-wicket to find the fence.
FOUR! Bludgeoned! Floated on off, Finch hammers it through mid off and the ball rockets to the fence. Also, the 100-run stand is up between the two. 12 from the over.

SIX! Not hit from the meat of the bat but these short boundaries are helping Australia! Floated on leg stump, Finch backs away and tries to go inside out over extra cover but only manages to get it towards long off. Bumrah near the fence is interested but can only see it sail over his head.
Landed around off, played with soft hands to cover-point.
Slips in the googly on middle, stays low. Aaron adjusts well to defend it off the back foot.
Flatter outside off, placed to backward point with an angled bat to backward point for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Finch eases it through mid off for a run.

David Warner talked about playing the Indian spinners better before the game and they have done that well so far. He blamed the situations for the collapses and till now, they have ensured that there aren't many bad shots played.
Tossed up around off, knocked down to long off for a run.

FOUR! Hit with a lot of authority! A fraction short on off, Finch rocks back and pulls it hard towards Jadeja (sub) at short mid-wicket. He dives to his right but the ball goes past him in a flash and races to the fence.
Quicker one on off, punched to short mid-wicket.
Finch missed out there! Short and outside off, Aaron cuts it towards covers but finds Kohli there. He is disappointed.
Drifting on the pads, Finch helps it to short fine leg.
Flatter delivery outside off, placed to cover-point for a quick run.
Spin in tandem now. Yuzvendra Chahal to roll his arm again.
Dhoni now has a word with Kuldeep. He has strayed on the pads far too often and hence not been threatening enough.
Floated delivery, Aaron lunges forward in defense.
Around the leg stump again, not the correct line to bowl. Flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
In the air... but safe! Floated on middle and leg, Finch goes for the big sweep but ends up getting a top edge. Chahal at short fine leg backpedals but the ball falls down safely. A run taken.
On the pads, clipped to backward square leg for a single.
Googly on middle and leg, Finch lunges to defend but gets an outside edge towards short third man. A run taken.
Fine leg now comes inside the ring.
Starts off with one outside leg, Smith paddle sweeps it towards fine leg. Pandya hares to his right, dives full length and makes a great stop. Saves a run for his side.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on.
Good length ball outside off, Smith places it through point for a run.
Full length ball on middle, knocked to long on for a run.

SIX! Brilliant! Overpitched on off, perhaps the slower one again. Finch knows that mid off is inside the ring and picks his spot. Strikes it cleanly over the long off fence for a maximum. He is playing really well.
Short of a length outside off, stays a bit low. Finch is beaten on the cut.
Fuller length ball on off, in fact it is the knuckle ball. Finch picks it and pushes it to covers.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Smith leans forward and times it nicely through cover-point for a run.
Similar in length around off, Finch lunges forward and defends it nicely. Steady over from Bumrah.
Fullish delivery on off, driven crisply to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Smith punches it off the back foot towards cover-point and calls for a single straightaway. Pandey hares across to his right but doesn't pick it quickly.
Short delivery outside off, Finch pulls it nicely to deep backward square leg for a run.
Good length delivery on off, angling in. Finch camps back and defends it stoutly.
Length delivery outside off, Finch taps it to point.
Another bowling change. Jasprit Bumrah comes back for a bowl. Virat Kohli is searching for wickets.
Shorter in length outside off, Finch tries to guide it down to third man but gets a bottom edge on the off side for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Fuller in length outside off, Steven drives it through covers for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Finch gets it off the inside half through mid on for a run.
Back of a length on off, Finch guides it to point.

Starts off with a loosener outside off. Finch cuts it through covers. The fielder in the deep does well as he runs to his left and stops it. The batsmen take two. The calf of finch is surely not giving him problems here.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back into the attack. India need him to get the breakthrough here.
Eases it down to long on for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Smith plants his front foot forward and drives it down to long off for a run.
A traditional leg spinner on leg stump. Finch flicks it down towards short fine leg for a run.
Foxed Finch here! Bowls a googly on leg stump. Finch fails to pick it. Aaron tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge towards covers.
Fuller in length on middle, Finch drives it back to the bowler.
Works it with the spin around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Exquisite! Best of the lot! Fuller in length around off, Finch leans into it and drives it beautifully through the cover region for a boundary.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Back of a length on off, Smith guides it through point for a run.
FOUR! Smith won't be missing out on these kind of deliveries. Pandya bowls it fuller on the pads. Smith flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back to the bowler.
Lands it on a length on off, Smith guides it to point.
Change of ends for Hardik Pandya.
Shorter in length on off, Smith punches it through the off side for a run.
Bowls it on middle, Smith defends it solidly.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it up on middle, Finch flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Kuldeep tosses it up on leg stump. Finch goes down on one knee and paddles it very, very fine, so fine that Dhoni who moves to his left gets beaten as the ball stays a touch low. It goes through his legs for a boundary.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket for a run.
Bowling change. Kuldeep Yadav to bowl now. He was terrific in the previous game. Can he weave his magic again?
Tosses it up on off, Finch defends it off the front foot.
Flatter on off, Finch defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! BOOM! That was hit really hard! Chahal bowls a tossed up ball on middle, Finch bludgeons it down the ground for a boundary. Fifty on return for the big man. 17th ODI fifty for him. He has really batted well here.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Fires it on the pads, Finch flicks it fine down the leg side. Bumrah from short fine leg gives it a chase, dives but fails to pull the ball back in. A boundary conceded.

Brilliant, brilliant effort by Pandey! Pandya bowls it on a length around off. Finch drives it towards the extra cover region and sets off for a run. Manish there dives to his right and makes a brilliant stop but is unable to score a direct hit. The batsmen complete a run. Had he hit, Finch was out.
Lands it on a length outside off. Smith gets it off the outer half down to third man for a run.
Good length outside off, stays a touch low. Smith tries to defend but gets beaten by the low bounce. We have seen the ball stay down on quite a few occasions.
Fullish length on off, Finch pushes it towards mid off and sets off for a run. Bumrah is quick to the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batsman has made his ground.
STREAKY FOUR! Finch won't mind. Pandya bowls it on a length outside off. Aaron tries to drive it on the up but gets an outside edge through the vacant slip region for a boundary.
Bowls it from wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Finch pushes it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floats it on middle, Smith drives it back to the bowler.

FOUR! He uses his feet ever so well! He has looked busy since he has come out. Chahal tosses it up on middle. Smith seeing the flight dances down the track and flicks it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Drags his length back outside off, Aaron cuts it through covers for a run.
Fires it on middle and leg. Finch flicks it towards short fine leg. He wants a run but is sent back by Smith.
Bowls a flipper on leg stump. Skids off the surface. Finch tries to play across the line but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Slower delivery on middle, Smith drives it back to the bowler.
Angles it on leg stump. Finch flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller in length on middle. Smith drives it down to long on for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Finch punches it through the off side for a run.

What was that now? Pandya bowls a full toss, a high full toss you can say outside off. Finch tries to hit it through the off side but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler. He immediately looks at the square leg umpire for a no ball but it is not given.
Lands it on a length on off, Finch defends it off the front foot.
MS Dhoni has a chat with Virat Kohli. Might be regarding the field placements. Fine leg is inside the circle now.
Tries to bowl it quicker and ends up serving a full toss on leg stump. Finch drives it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and quicker on  middle. Finch defends it back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
SIX! Effortless by the big man! Such is the power of Finch. Chahal bowls a googly on off. He just bowls it a tad full. Finch picks it well and lofts it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Floats it on leg stump, Finch tries to drive but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg.
Flighted ball on middle, Steven Smith leans into it and eases it down to long on for a run.

DRINKS! So, Australia are off to a decent start. Warner and Finch started off really well but as David tried to take the attack to the bowlers he was dismissed by Pandya. Both the teams will be happy with how things have panned out in the first hour.
Good length on off, Finch drives it to mid on.
Fuller in length on off, Smith takes a step ahead and drives it confidently towards mid off for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Finch drives it through covers for a run.
BEATEN! He is oozing in confidence after that wicket he got. A slower one bowled to great effect. Lands it on a length around off. Finch tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Pandya goes wide of the crease and bowls it on middle. Smith shuffles across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls a cutter on off, Smith guides it towards point for no run.
Fuller in length on off, Steven drives it through mid off for a run.
Floats it on middle, Smith defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it up on off, Smith drives it to mid off.
Flicks it through the leg side, against the spin for a run.
Shorter and outside off. The ball skids through the surface. Finch tries to cut but gets beaten.

FOUR! What a way to get off the mark. Pandya bowls it on middle. Trying to get Smith LBW but he is up for it. He flicks it through mid-wicket. Kuldeep the fielder in the deep dives but in vain and the ball crosses the boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Angles it into the pads. Smith flicks it to mid-wicket.
Steven Smith, the skipper is the next man in. With the opening pair having provided a solid start, he needs to capitalize on it.

OUT! Hardik draws first blood! A much-needed wicket here for the Indians. Pandya bowls an off cutter on middle. It cuts away after pitching. Warner tries to defend but gets beaten and the ball hits the top of middle. The umpires check upstairs for the no ball but it is fine. Warner has to walk back. A big wicket for India. The southpaw was looking dangerous. A nice opening partnership comes to an end.
Back of a length on middle, Warner defends it off the back foot.

FOUR! Sloppy from Jadhav! That should have been stopped. A touch fuller in length on off, Warner pushes it towards the right of mid off. Kedar there runs towards the ball but dives over it and concedes a boundary. Warner is on the charge here.
Warner and Finch take a bit of a breather. It is really hot, the visitors will be tested once again.
Floats it up on off, Warner eases it down to long off for a run.
Tosses it up on middle. Finch drives it down to long on for a run.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! BANG! A flat maximum. Chahal tosses it up on off, Warner hits it over the bowler's head and over the fence for a biggie. First of the innings.
Fuller in length on off, Warner drives it through the covers for a brace.

He tries play the reverse sweep, a shot which he played very successfully in the Indian T20 League. Chahal bowls it very full and quick around off. Warner misses and is struck on the pads. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. The impact was the issue there.
On a length outside off, tapped to point. Umpire Marais Erasmus has a chat with Pandya as he landed on the danger area in his followthrough. A friendly warning. He needs to be careful.
Fuller in length on off, Warner lunges forward and pushes it to mid off. Calls for a run immediately taking on Chahal. Good judgement as the batsmen complete it with ease.
Angling into Finch. He tucks it to mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Pandya comes from around the wicket and bowls a back of a length delivery outside off. David slaps it to sweeper cover for a run.
Similar length delivery around off, punched to point this time.

Good length delivery on off, Warner taps it towards cover-point and looks for a run. His partner responds but is send back rightly. Rahane runs across from point and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Another bowling change. Hardik Pandya to bowl now.
Works it with the spin through the leg side for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fires it on the pads, Finch fails to flick and the ball takes the pads as it goes on the leg side for a run.
Fuller in length on middle. Finch tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards covers.
Flatter on middle, Finch punches it back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! The dive saves Finch! Warner plays it toward mid-wicket with the spin and sets off for a run. Kohli runs to his left and is quick to the ball as he scores a direct hit at the striker's end. He is confident and appeals. The umpire takes it up stairs. Replays show that Finch has made his ground in time. His calf was tested there. A good run in the end. It was difficult for Kohli as it was hit to his left which is not his throwing hand. Also, this brings up the fifty for Australia.
Direct hits are always close and there is one at the striker's end by Kohli. The umpire goes upstairs. The Indians feel Finch is short of his ground.

Powerplay 2 has been signaled by the umpire. Four fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over. Meanwhile, spin is introuduced into the attack. Yuzvendra Chahal to roll his arm over now. A slip in place.

Comes around the wicket and bowls it on a length around off. Warner pushes it towards covers and takes off for a run. The fielder there has a shy at the non striker's end but misses. Kohli who is backing up misfields and the batsman take two overthrows. Three in total.
Back of a length on off, Finch pushes it towards cover for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Finch flicks it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

Angles it on the leg stump. Finch flicks it through mid-wicket. Chahal in the deep runs to his left to collect the ball.The batsmen complete one and Warner turns and runs for a second and makes it in time.
Back of a length on off, Finch pushes it to mid off.
MS Dhoni has a word with Kumar as the latter goes to his fielding position. He didn't quite hit the lengths India may have needed him to. Australia have got off to a good start here.
Kumar comes running in and lands it on a length on off, Warner defends it solidly towards cover.
Bowls it on the leg stump, Warner flicks it to short mid-wicket with the angle.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Warner guides it to point.

FOUR! This is beautiful by Warner! Kumar does not bowl a bad delivery here. He bowls it tad fuller in length on off. Warner leans into it and drives it through the gap between extra cover and mid off for a boundary. An excellent start here for Australia.

FOUR! Signs of Kumar getting tired? He angles it on the pads. Warner flicks it towards short fine leg. Kuldeep there dives to his right but fails to stop it and the ball races to the fence. Yadav should have put in a better effort there.
Lands it on a length around off. Warner guides it down to third man for a run.
Sanjay Manjrekar on-air makes a good point. He says that Kohli has assessed the track and knows that it is two-paced. He has taken out the slip fielders and is concentrating on saving runs.
Shorter in length outside off, Finch cuts it through backward point and down to third man for a run.

FOUR! This time he gets a boundary through that region! Bumrah bowls it full on the pads, Finch manages to flick it uppishly but wide of short fine leg for a boundary. These are easy pickings for Finch.
Angles it on the pads, Finch flicks it through backward square leg and collects a brace.
Flicks the ball on the pads to mid-wicket.

Close shave! Good length on off, Warner pushes it on the up towards Kohli at covers and sets off for a run. Kohli is quick to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A run added to the total. Replays show had he hit, Warner was a dead duck.
Fuller in length on off, Finch mistimes his drive to covers.
Kumar is erring in line to the left-hander. He bowls it on the pads of Warner who gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls on the leg side for a run.
Lands it on a length around off, Finch tries to force it through covers but gets it off the outer half towards backward point. Manish Pandey there dives to his left but the batsmen take a run.
Tight bowling here from Kumar! He lands it on the good length area once again on off. Finch defends it off the front foot.
An extra fielder at covers now.
Good length on off, Finch plants his front foot forward and defends it.
Back of a length on off, Finch defends it solidly.
Flicks it with the angle to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lovely bowling! Bumrah goes wide of the crease and lands it on a length. Angling it into the batsman. The ball straightens a touch and Finch is beaten as he tries to defend.
Back of a length outside off, Finch punches it towards cover-point. He wants a run but is sent back by Warner seeing Rohit get to the ball quickly. He has a shy but does not hit. No harm done.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A touch fuller in length on off, Finch pushes it to covers.
Lands it on a length on off, David defends it solidly.
FOUR! Poor line! Warner won't miss out on those. Kumar bowls a freebie on the pads. Warner flicks it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Angles it into the pads. Warner flicks it to short mid-wicket.
The ball has been square driven by the batsman.
Fuller on off, nips into the batsman. Warner tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket. The fielder Chahal from deep square leg does well to stop it before the boundary. The batsmen take two.
Slower ball on middle, Finch picks it early and defends it.
WIDE! Fires it down the leg side. Finch misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Shorter in length around off by Bumrah. Finch punches it off the back foot through covers. The outfield is lightning fast and the ball races to the fence.
Angles it on the pads, Finch tries to clip it fine but misses. The ball hits the pads and goes on the bounce to the keeper. Finch will feel he missed out there.
EDGY FOUR! Bumrah bowls it fuller in length around off, Finch tries to drive it down the ground but gets an outside edge through the slip region for a boundary. First boundary for Australia.
BEATEN! Shorter in length outside off. Finch seeing the width on offer goes for the cut but gets beaten.
Bumrah also comes around the wicket and lands it on a length on off. Warner taps it towards cover and sets off for a run. Kohli comes running in but fails to collect the ball. A single taken.
Shorter in length around off, Finch pushes it on the off side. A good tight over by Kumar. Only one run from it.
Silly mid on in place now.
Back of a length on off, Warner guides it past point for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Warner drives it straight. The bowler does well to bend down and stop the ball.
Changes his angle, comes around the wicket and angles it into the batsman. Warner defends it back to the bowler.
Square leg goes back and fine leg comes inside the ring. Meanwhile, Warner has an issue with the sightscreen as he stops Kumar in his followthrough.
Again the ball stays a touch low! Kumar bowls it shorter in length outside off, Warner goes for the cut but gets beaten. The ball goes on the bounce to the keeper. Surely does not look a belter.
Kumar comes running in and bowls it on middle and leg. Angles it away from the left-hander. Warner defends it solidly.
Length ball on off, Finch pushes it towards point.
Fuller in length on off, Warner pushes it towards mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder rushes to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. No harm done.
Good length on off, David defends it off the front foot.
That stays low! Bumrah lands it on a length around off, angling away. Warner tries to defend it but is beaten by the low bounce. Already signs of the pitch being two-paced.
WIDE! Bowls it way outside off, Warner does opt to fiddle with it. The ball goes along the ground to the keeper. The umpire signals a wide.
Back of a length on off, Warner punches it towards cover. A confident looking punch there.
Bumrah with his strange action angles it into the pads of Finch. He easily flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
Jasprit Bumrah will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Finch is off the mark! Kumar angles it on the pads from wide of the crease. Finch flicks it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder makes a half-stop and parries it towards mid on for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Finch lets it be.
Fuller in length on middle, Finch pushes it back to the bowler.

In the air... but just wide! Kumar bowls a back of a length ball outside off, Warner plays it away from his body uppishly towards backward point. Pandey there dives full stretch to his right but could not reach it and the ball goes to third man for a run.
WIDE! Sprays it down the leg side. Warner misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide. Australia get their first run courtesy of an extra.
Errs in line. Kumar bowls it on the pads of Warner who fails to flick and the ball strikes him on the thigh pad.
Starts off right on the money! Kumar comes running in and lands it on a length around off. The ball swings in a touch. Warner camps back and defends it.

After the national anthems are done and dusted, we are all set to get underway. The returning Aaron Finch and the dynamic David Warner will open the batting for Australia. Bhuvneshwar Kumar who was brilliant with the ball in the last game will start off the proceedings for India. He has two slips in place. Here we go...
Both the teams are out for their respective national anthems.

Virat Kohli says that they would have batted first as well. Reckons that the pitch will settle down under lights and it might be a bit dry in the first half. States that they are playing with the same team.

Steven Smith says he will bat first. He reckons it is a good wicket and they would want to make good use of it. He hopes they can post a good total. He informs there are two changes, Aaron Finch and Peter Handscomb (to keep wickets) come into the side in place of Hilton Cartwright and Matthew Wade.
TOSS - Steven Smith wins his first toss of the series and he elects to bat first.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar and Michael Clarke say, the pitch looks like a belter. Mention the dew factor might come into play later. They reckon both teams will want to bat first on this wicket. Opine that it looks like a 300-plus pitch.

The Indians on the other hand, are firing on all cylinders. Virat Kohli would want the series to be done and dusted here. It would be interesting to see if Lokesh Rahul gets a game in place of Manish Pandey who has not been among the runs in this series. We can expect a cracking encounter. Stay tuned for the toss and further updates.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the 3rd ODI between India and Australia in Indore. A must win clash for the Australians today as they aim to stay alive in the series. Their batting has not been up to the mark and Smith would hope for the big guns to fire. We might see some changes in their eleven today. Finch if passed fit, could return to the line-up in place of Cartwright who has had a dismal run with the bat. Also, Handscomb could replace Wade who is also struggling to make an impact with the willow.
